dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: This is the Palais Mermonia. This is where all official affairs are handled, and public services are rendered.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: Of course, this is also the abode of Lady Furina, the Hydro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: Meetings with her are by appointment only, so please follow the rules and refrain from intruding — there will be consequences otherwise.
